Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private/VPC architecture review — next steps

Hi Sam / Priya,

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the context on Acme Health's latency targets and the compliance constraints around PHI. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Recap: you’re evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for production inference of clinical note summarization. Key constraints: SOC2+HIPAA, private VPC peering, dedicated GPU capacity for predictable throughput.
- Next meeting: technical architecture review / deep-dive with your infra team to validate network requirements, egress patterns, and KMS options. We recommend 60–90 minutes.
- Attendees we suggest: Marissa (Solutions), Dev (SE/arch), your infra lead (networking/VPC), and a security contact.

I’m attaching a short Private/VPC overview and a preliminary network checklist to help frame the discussion. Can you share 2–3 windows on your side this week or next? If helpful, here’s a Calendly link with my open slots: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/marissa-private-vpc-60

Proposed agenda (60 min):
1) Brief intro & objectives (5 min)
2) Target architecture & connection patterns (15 min)
3) Network/firewall/KMS details and required artifacts (25 min)
4) Next steps / actions (15 min)

If you want to invite any additional folks (e.g., procurement, security), now’s a great time.

Thanks — looking forward to lining something up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments:
- redwood-private-vpc-overview.pdf
- acme-network-checklist.xlsx

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Priya and I reviewed this internally and we’d like to move to the architecture deep-dive next.

Availability from our side:
- Wed, Jul 8: 09:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, Jul 9: 13:00–16:00 PT

I’ve looped in our infra team (infra@acmehealth.com) and they asked whether you can share any example VPC peering diagrams and the list of required CIDR ranges up front so they can confirm firewall rules ahead of the call. Also, is Redwood able to support KMS integration with our HashiCorp Vault in a private deployment?

Thanks,

Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700

Hi Sam — thanks for the quick reply and for looping infra in. Wed 07/08 09:00 PT works for us; I’ll mark that as tentative.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Example diagrams: attaching a simple VPC peering diagram (also in the Drive folder linked above). The PDF shows both peering and private-hosting (VPC + private control plane) options.
- CIDR ranges: Redwood needs two outbound ranges for egress to the control plane (we can provide exact /24s prior to the call) and a configurable set of allowed inbound rules for health checks — we’ll send a cleaned checklist by EOD.
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys and HSM integrations. For Vault specifically, we typically integrate using an internal KMS sync or via a Cloud KMS wrapper depending on the deployment; we’ll match to your compliance requirements during the architecture call.

I’ve scheduled a 60-minute slot in my calendar for Wed 2026-07-08 09:00 PT — please confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite that includes a Zoom link and the Drive artefacts (network checklist + diagram).

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- redwood-private-vpc-overview.pdf
- acme-network-checklist.xlsx
